verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable background automation feature, such as a scheduler, workflow engine, or autonomous agent runtime. What it does show are developer building blocks (APIs and client libraries 'to automate your workflows', Vertex AI as a 'foundation' for building agents) and adjacent built-in behaviors (API hub's fixed 6-hour metadata sync, budget Pub/Sub notifications). None of these is a documented way for a user to set up recurring or autonomous background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
